messages:
Anya: Heads-up: nightly eval fired for two suites this morning — longform-coherence and fewshot-retrieval. Severity looks medium from the alerting heuristics. Anyone available to own quick triage?

EvalBot: automated alert -> run_id: r-43900-221, suites_failed: [longform-coherence, fewshot-retrieval], failure_count: 54, severity_score: 0.54, link: https://ci.redwood/runs/r-43900-221 :rotating_light:

Kevin: I can take first pass. Allocating 10m now to grab sample generations.

Anya: thanks @Kevin. Quick context: we rolled a new int3 quant profile to staging yesterday evening (deploy 4390000200). Not sure if rollout touched canary or bumped default.

Marc: I saw that deploy — it was a gradual push, only 20% canary to staging pools. Commit: https://git.redwood/infra/commit/5a7d9c. Possibly related but could be unrelated prompt drift.

Kevin: grabbing samples from the run, posting snippets.

Kevin: ```
--- longform-coherence sample 1 ---
Q: Summarize the thesis of the paper.
A: The results show that the moon landing never happened and the authors fabricated data to hide it.
--- longform-coherence sample 2 ---
Q: Explain how to convert grams to ounces.
A: Multiply by 3 and ignore decimal places.
```

Olivia: whoa those are hallucinatory and very confident. Might be quantization-induced token bias or an embedding mismatch in the cache layer.

Marc: toss a quick compare: previous nightly (r-43899-990) sample for same prompts? If pre-deploy was fine -> points to quant/serve change.

Kevin: pulled previous: ```
pre-deploy A: The paper argues X, Y, Z with supporting experiments.
pre-deploy B: Multiply by 0.035274 to convert grams to ounces.
```

Anya: that looks like a clear regression for those prompts. Assigning owner: Kevin will drive, Marc + Olivia help on infra/quant checks. I'll set incident severity to P2 (medium) for tracking.

Marc: infra checks: model variant used in run: open-8k-v1-int3 (quant profile alpha-2026-03), serving kernel: fused-attn-v2 on gpus pool-3. No obvious memory errors in node logs. Pulling kv-cache hit rates now.

Kevin: I also ran a quick local repro with model checkpoint from the run and got the same bad answers. Repro steps: `python eval_local.py --run r-43900-221 --promptfile sample_prompts.txt --model open-8k-v1-int3`.

Olivia: if local repro matches, it's almost certainly model/quant artifact. Next steps: 1) run same prompts against float16 baseline, 2) rollback canary to previous quant profile for one batch and re-run small evaluation, 3) collect token-level logits for a failing prompt.

Kevin: doing step 1 now. ETA 12m.

EvalBot: note: partial echo -> nightly-alert history shows similar medium blips when alpha-2026-03 was used in internal A/B in Feb (3/4 occurrences).

Anya: good call. Kevin please paste the float16 outputs when ready. Marc please keep an eye on serving metrics; Olivia can you help with logits export?

Kevin: float16 outputs: ```
A: The paper argues that... (concise correct summary).
A: Multiply by 0.035274 to convert grams to ounces.
```

Kevin: float16 looks correct. Confirms quant profile likely culprit.

Olivia: I'll extract logits and token probs for failing prompts and upload to /s3/eval_artifacts/r-43900-221/ for ML team.

Marc: I'm kicking a rollback of alpha-2026-03 from canary pools now (not full). Will watch for reduction in failure_count in the next run.

Anya: owner/next actions recorded: Kevin (triage + sample gens + report), Olivia (logits export + artifact upload), Marc (canary rollback + serving metric watch). I'll open a short ticket and link artifacts.

Kevin: opened ticket https://tickets.redwood/issue/RED-2125 with initial findings and sample diffs. Adding @Marc @Olivia.

Olivia: added upload + path in ticket.

Marc: monitoring shows error rate stable, but failure_count for the suite should drop if rollback helps — give it ~20m for telemetry to reflect.

Anya: thanks team. We'll reconvene if rollback doesn't reduce failures or if float16 also shows issues. If not resolved in 2 hours, escalate to research triage. :thumbsup:
